title: Absolute Target Expression in Normal Oral Basal Keratinocytes Predicts Antibody–Drug Conjugate Stomatitis and Re-Ranks Oral Cavity Carcinoma Targets (Analysis Code and Curated Data)
description: Reproducible Python and R analysis pipeline, dual-curated 66-ADC clinical monotherapy stomatitis tables, processed multi-omic summary matrices, deterministic Ruifrok-Johnston rgb2hed HPA normal squamous IHC optical density tables, leave-one-target-out calibration outputs, openFDA FAERS pharmacovigilance tables, and 420-gene OSCC surfaceome re-ranking archive.
